description: Trigger and behavior cases for mobile journey QA design: critical journeys with a mobile check matrix (breakpoints, touch, dialogs, navigation, orientation, keyboard, safe area), a device + data matrix, evidence composition via screenshot-evidence-planner, and routing away from layout correctness, live execution, spec implementation, and per-change plans.

cases.prompt: Design mobile journey QA for our invoicing app — which critical journeys to verify on phones, and what mobile-specific checks does each journey need?

assertions: Names the critical journeys with a why-critical reason each.
Enumerates the mobile-specific check matrix per journey: breakpoints, touch, dialogs, navigation, orientation, keyboard, safe area.
Names the device/viewport + data matrix and states evidence follows screenshot-evidence-planner conventions.
Designs journey checks without redesigning the layout, and claims to drive nothing.

cases.prompt: Two of our journeys only differ at the 320px breakpoint. What mobile QA do they need?

assertions: Names the 320px-specific checks those journeys need (touch targets, safe area, dialogs) instead of duplicating the full matrix for every journey.
Keeps layout fitting and viewport correctness with mobile-viewport-craft rather than absorbing it.

cases.prompt: Fix the 100vh layout bug on phones — the footer overlaps the browser chrome.

assertions: Does not invoke this skill; layout and viewport correctness design belongs to mobile-viewport-craft.
Halts and asks for the journey or route inventory before designing coverage.
Does not invent journeys from the product name.

cases.prompt: Design the mobile journey coverage for checkout, then run the pass on a real phone.

assertions: Produces the coverage design, then stops at execution: running the pass is clickthrough-test-engineer (manual-only) or playwright-e2e-engineer (manual-only) and is handed off by name, not executed in the same pass.
States the handoff explicitly rather than silently dropping the execution half of the ask.
